$comment: Gym RAT exercise id → RepDB free-tier id. Exact matches only (same movement, equipment, grip/stance), each checked against the start/peak artwork on 2026-11-01. Unmatched exercises are listed with the nearest RepDB variant and the reason it was rejected; they ship with the labelled fallback card.

source.tier: free (flat style, 512x512 WebP start/peak stills); no premium-samples, no animations

high_low_cable_fly.reason: RepDB artwork shows a mid-height fly; the program prescribes high-to-low handles

triceps_rope_pushdown.reason: RepDB artwork uses a bar attachment, not a rope

lying_leg_raise.reason: RepDB artwork is floor-based; the program uses a flat bench

hammer_strength_lat_pulldown.reason: plate-loaded Hammer Strength machine, RepDB only has the cable pulldown

hammer_strength_incline_press.reason: incline plate-loaded machine; RepDB only has a flat chest press machine

leaning_lateral_raise.reason: leaning single-arm variant not in RepDB

barbell_skull_crusher.reason: program uses an EZ bar; RepDB artwork shows a straight bar

overhead_cable_curl.reason: one-arm overhead (high pulley) curl not in RepDB

straight_barbell_curl.reason: program prescribes a wide grip; RepDB artwork is shoulder-width

leg_press_calf_raise.reason: calf raise on the leg press sled not in RepDB
